---
title: "Environment"
---

The Workbench uses a project-local Python environment and pinned runtime files so new contributors and CI runs resolve the same toolchain.

## Runtime Pins

- Python: `3.14`
- Node.js: `24.19.0`
- Python environment: `.venv`
- Python package manager: `uv`
- Website renderer: Quarto

## Local Setup

```bash
uv venv .venv --python 3.14
uv sync --all-extras
```

The `.venv/` directory is ignored by Git. Commit version pins and lockfiles, not local environments.

## Version Files

```text
.python-version
.node-version
.nvmrc
pyproject.toml
uv.lock
```

These files communicate the intended runtime to local shells, editors, CI, and future automation.

## Editor Expectations

VS Code is configured to use `.venv/bin/python`, pytest, Ruff, and the `make site` task for rendering the full GitHub Pages tree.
